messages.subject: remove some rows of data frame  based on criteria in another data frame
parts:
Hi all

I am doing a simulation with R and the results of one step of simulation is data frame. unfortunately, some rows of my data frame all are  NA randomly and i have to remove the empathy rows from data frame. i do it by this command:

df[rowSums(is.na(df)) != ncol(df), ]

but i need to remove the same rows in the another data frame to make there dimension equal. but i can not do it. could any one help to solve my problem?

Best

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: remove some rows of data frame  based on criteria in another data frame
parts:
Hi B.,

Is the output of ctmm's simulate function giving NA values? If so, I would rather fix that by you sending me a minimal working example (data + script).

Otherwise you could just store an intermediate vector for the rows that you intend to delete:

NAS <- apply(df,1,function(row) any(is.na(row)) )

and then remove them from both data frames like

df <- df[!NAS,]

Best,
Chris
